facts.claim_text: Continue arterial line monitoring with zero/calibration and occlusive dressing checks.
facts.text: The patient has an arterial line.
notes: concept set by the rule files: blood_pressure -> other
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The arterial line procedure record shows the line ran from 2145-09-28 21:22 to 2145-09-29 13:26, ending about 7.5 hours before the decision time, and no arterial line measurements appear after 13:00, so the records show the line was stopped before the decision time.

facts.claim_text: Continue continuous pulse oximetry and ST segment monitoring with current alarm limits.
facts.text: The patient is currently on continuous pulse oximetry.
notes: concept set by the rule files: spo2 -> heart_rate
facts.label: not_addressed
facts.reason: The records show hourly O2 saturation pulseoxymetry measurements through 12:00, but the most recent reading is about 9 hours before the decision time and the 16:00 and 20:00 assessments contain no SpO2 rows. No record explicitly shows continuous pulse oximetry running at the decision time, and the absence of recent readings does not prove it was stopped.
